--- title: "Data Out: Catalogue Publication" subtitle: "while something is happening here, something else is happening there" format: html: toc: true code-fold: true code-summary: "Show code" execute: echo: true --- This page brings together the exhibition-level record and the list of artworks associated with the exhibition. It is built from the workflows in [notebooks/01-exhibition.ipynb](notebooks/01-exhibition.ipynb) and [notebooks/02-artworks.ipynb](notebooks/02-artworks.ipynb). ## 1. Exhibition information The exhibition record is based on Wikidata item Q141747732 and summarises the main statements for the event. ::: {#eee8f767 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {} #| code-fold: true #| code-summary: "Click here to see the Python code" from urllib.parse import urlencode from urllib.request import Request, urlopen import json from html import escape from IPython.display import HTML, display item_id = "Q141747732" property_map = { "P31": "Instance of", "P1476": "Title", "P276": "Location", "P580": "Start time", "P582": "End time", "P1640": "Curator", "P710": "Participant", "P856": "Official website", "P664": "Organizer", "P17": "Country", "P407": "Language", "P921": "Theme", "P859": "Sponsor", "P1174": "Number of visitors", "P373": "Commons category", } value_props = " ".join(f"wd:{pid}" for pid in property_map) query = f""" SELECT ?prop ?propLabel ?value ?valueLabel WHERE {{ BIND(wd:{item_id} AS ?item) VALUES ?prop {{ {value_props} }} BIND(IRI(CONCAT("http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/", STRAFTER(STR(?prop), "entity/"))) AS ?wdtProp) ?item ?wdtProp ?value . SERVICE wikibase:label {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,[AUTO_LANGUAGE]". }} }} ORDER BY ?prop ?valueLabel """ endpoint = "https://query.wikidata.org/sparql" params = urlencode({"query": query, "format": "json"}) url = f"{endpoint}?{params}" request = Request( url, headers={ "Accept": "application/sparql-results+json", "User-Agent": "loe-posit-notebook/1.0 (contact: simon.worthington@tib.eu)", }, ) with urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response: data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8")) rows = [] for b in data["results"]["bindings"]: prop_uri = b["prop"]["value"] pid = prop_uri.rsplit("/", 1)[-1] prop_name = property_map.get(pid, b.get("propLabel", {}).get("value", pid)) value_text = b.get("valueLabel", {}).get("value", b["value"]["value"]) rows.append({"property_id": pid, "property": prop_name, "value": value_text}) rows = list({(r["property_id"], r["value"]): r for r in rows}.values()) rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["property_id"], str(r["value"]).lower())) if rows: headers = ["property_id", "property", "value"] table = [ "", *[f"" for h in headers], "", ] for row in rows: table.append( "" + "".join(f"" for h in headers) + "" ) table.append("
{escape(h)}
{escape(str(row.get(h, '')))}
") display(HTML("".join(table))) else: print("No exhibition data was returned.") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html}

SERVICE wikibase:label {{ bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en". }} }} LIMIT 100 """ endpoint = "https://query.wikidata.org/sparql" params = urlencode({"query": query, "format": "json"}) url = f"{endpoint}?{params}" request = Request( url, headers={ "Accept": "application/sparql-results+json", "User-Agent": "loe-posit-notebook/1.0 (contact: simon.worthington@tib.eu)", }, ) with urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response: data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8")) rows = [] for b in data["results"]["bindings"]: rows.append( { "artwork_id": b["artwork"]["value"].rsplit("/", 1)[-1], "artwork": b.get("artworkLabel", {}).get("value", b["artwork"]["value"]), } ) if rows: headers = ["artwork_id", "artwork"] table = [ "", *[f"" for h in headers], "", ] for row in rows: table.append( "" + "".join(f"" for h in headers) + "" ) table.append("
